_comment: Auth context v1 — the shared truth table for what a valid capability is. Read by BOTH src/agento/toolbox/tests/auth-context-fixture.test.js (Node deriveAuthContext, the verifier) and tests/unit/framework/test_auth_context_fixture.py (Python derive_auth_context, the issuer). Timestamps are epoch seconds. `source` is what the source checker returned for the row (null = revoked/ended/unknown). `expected` null means rejected. A divergence is fail-open on one side, so the table lives in one file. E2/E6 mint from this shape; see docs/architecture/auth-context.md.
